10. After anonymising a project it has no revision: correcting or erasing it
    stating its former revision is refused as stale and changes nothing; a
    project deleted whole is not found.
   Shows A04-4, A04-5. [witness: verification:registry_a04_anonymised_project_former_revision_stale]
statements:
```text
answer(a) = first failing check of a in the order (1)..(6), else its effect   -- A04-1
action a that may move the revision of r in {Project, Customer}, with
a.stated_revision != r.revision => refused, r unchanged   -- A04-2
action a that may move the revision of r in {Project, Customer}, accepted,
changed(r), r keeping a revision => r.revision' = r.revision + 1 and
r.last_changed' = now   -- A04-3
accepted erasure, anonymisation or deletion of r in {Project, Customer} =>
r has no revision after   -- A04-4
action a on r in {Project, Customer} with no revision, a.stated_revision
present => refused as stale, r unchanged   -- A04-5
action a that may move the revision of r in {Project, Customer}, accepted,
not changed(r) => r.revision' = r.revision   -- A04-6
```

verdicts.why: The check verifies that accepted anonymisation yields the restricted anonymised form with no revision, then detects stale refusals for correction, re-anonymisation, and whole deletion using the former revision while confirming both the readable card and persisted rows remain unchanged. It also deletes a separate project whole and verifies that both correction and reading return the defined not-found refusal.
